visual.general_description: Three-panel figure of Case 3 resection specimen: gross photograph and two H&E-like micrographs.
visual.detailed_description: Three vertically stacked panels. A is a color gross photograph of an opened bowel segment with brown and pale cream mucosa meeting at a whitish scarred band, with an unnumbered ruler strip. B is a low-power stained section with fat, dense pink fibrous tissue and a black boxed area, with a 5 mm scale bar. C is a higher-power field with a central pale necrotic-appearing zone ringed by inflammatory cells, with a 250 μm scale bar.

panels.general_description: Gross photograph of an opened resected bowel segment with a pale scarred narrowed zone between dark brown and pale cream mucosa, with an unlabeled black ruler strip.
panels.detailed_description: Color photograph of an opened bowel segment on a light gray background. The left half has brown mucosa with transverse folds and a dark brown patch near the center; the right half is pale cream-yellow mucosa with a more fanned appearance. At the junction there is a whitish fibrous band with scar-like tissue, and a small brownish nodular or ulcerated spot in the lower right pale portion. A black ruler strip with white tick marks (about 14 intervals, no numerals) runs along the bottom. Only the panel letter A is printed; proximal/distal orientation is not labeled.
